lsc_selectivity.definition: The practice of choosing fewer people and refusing more, so that the chosen ones get more of you.
lsc_selectivity.example: Her selectivity is not rudeness; it is a policy she applies to everybody.

mon_unit_of_account.definition: The job money does when it is the common measure of what things cost.
mon_unit_of_account.example: At 3 $ the coffee and 2 $ the ticket, the unit of account makes the two prices comparable.

psy_boundary.definition: A line you draw around your time, energy, body or values, and say out loud so other people can respect it.
psy_boundary.example: Her boundary was simple: no phone calls after ten.

taste.definition: What your tongue tells you when you eat. Sweet, sour, salty and bitter are the four main tastes.
taste.example: The taste of this mango is very sweet.
